envelope.description: Add toGraphvizDot() IR-to-DOT emitter to fallback.ts

body.title: Add toGraphvizDot() IR-to-DOT emitter to fallback.ts
body.summary: Implement toGraphvizDot(ir) in fallback.ts: emits a Graphviz DOT digraph over ir.derived nodes/edges using short n0,n1,... aliases (never raw entity ids) with DOT-escaped labels.
acceptanceChecks: toGraphvizDot(ir) emits one DOT node per ir.derived node using n<i> aliases and one 'from->to' edge per ir.derived edge
node labels containing DOT-hostile characters (quotes, backslashes, newlines) are escaped and yield well-formed, parseable DOT
toGraphvizDot() performs no I/O and only reflects graph-derived content (no narrated/invented text)

tests.name: toGraphvizDot(ir): a valid digraph over derived nodes/edges (n<i> aliases, one edge per IrEdge); DOT-hostile label chars are escaped
